product.description: The TerraGrip Garden Rake 12 delivers a robust solution for clearing leaves, grass clippings, and debris across lawns and flower beds. Its 90‑cm steel tines are forged for durability, while the 20‑cm wide head ensures efficient coverage. A 10‑cm wooden handle offers a comfortable grip and ergonomic support during extended use. The bright red finish resists fading and adds a splash of color to any gardening kit. Designed for general outdoor maintenance, this rake is lightweight yet sturdy, making it suitable for both amateur gardeners and seasoned landscapers.
